title: The Unknown Chamber
shot: wide reveal from the passage mouth, then medium
camera: emerge from the passage and crane up into the dome
action: The narrow passage opens into a huge underground chamber. In its centre stands an ancient stone platform. KAIRO stops and stares.
lighting: cool light from above the dome plus a faint warm glow from the platform edge
audio: huge reverb bloom, the tone now clearly coming from the platform, air movement
dialogue_fa: بعد از چند دقیقه رسیدم به یه جای بزرگ... یه چیزی وسط اون اتاق بود که اصلاً انتظارشو نداشتم.
gloss_en: After a few minutes I reached a big place... there was something in the middle of that room that I did not expect at all.
continuity: platform at chamber centre, recreated in S20-S24
dome ceiling with faint light shafts
transition: his eye-line drops to the top of the platform, motivating the map reveal
image_prompt: Wide interior of a vast domed underground chamber. Rough stone walls rise into darkness, faint cold light shafts fall from an unseen fissure above, dust in the beams. At the centre stands a waist-high ancient stone platform, its edges carved with worn patterns. KAIRO the stickman is a small figure at the left, spear hanging from one hand, staring up. 2D cinematic animation, epic scale, painterly rock texture.
video_prompt: Camera emerges from the narrow passage into the chamber and cranes slowly upward, revealing how enormous the dome is. Light shafts shift in the dust. KAIRO walks three steps in and stops, head tilting back, spear forgotten at his side.
